issues: Whether a police stop on the street without reasonable grounds constitutes an unlawful detention under section 9 of the Charter
Whether the search that led to the discovery of drugs was unreasonable under section 8 of the Charter
Whether evidence obtained in violation of Charter rights should be excluded under section 24(2) of the Charter
Whether the right to counsel under section 10 of the Charter was breached during questioning
Admissibility of statements made during an unlawful detention
The standard for reasonable grounds to detain and the scope of police powers during an investigative stop
key_facts: Police stopped the client on the street
No reasonable grounds for the stop
Drugs were found as a result
causes_of_action: Motion to exclude evidence under s. 24(2) of the Charter

Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms, s. 9
Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms, s. 10
Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms, s. 24(2)
Criminal Code, R.S.C. 1985, c. C-46 (search and seizure provisions)
search_terms: scope of police powers during stop
